name: desk-mcp
description: Windows desktop automation MCP server: screenshots, OCR, mouse and keyboard input, and element trees from UI Automation, MSAA and Chrome DevTools Protocol. Zero external binaries.
long_description: 42 tools over a pure Node.js stdio server backed by the PowerShell that ships with Windows, so there is nothing to install and nothing to compile. Reads degrade in order: UI Automation, then MSAA through oleacc, then the Chrome DevTools Protocol for Chromium pages, then OCR. Every UI Automation call runs on an STA thread with a hard timeout, and a per-window circuit breaker blocks a key for 90 s after a hang, so one frozen application does not stall the agent. Actions go through UI Automation patterns, so the mouse does not have to move. Windows only.
